channel.description: Latest articles from Majorca Daily Bulletin (majorcadailybulletin.com)

item.title: Calls for an end of vehicle restrictions in the Balearics: ‘It’s climate big brother’
item.description: According to the party, current mobility policies, based on vehicle entry quotas and environmental restrictions, are violating the constitutional right to free movement.

item.title: Mallorcan hotelier Gabriel Escarrer named among world’s most influential travel industry leaders
item.description: He has also been ranked among the top ten business leaders in Spain.

item.title: Mallorca weather for Tuesday, February 24: Yellow fog warning issued for the morning, but spring-like weather continues
item.description: Mallorca is expected to see a change in weather conditions later this week, according to María José Guerrero, delegate and spokesperson for the Agencia Estatal de Meteorología (Aemet) in the Balearic Islands. Forecast models currently indicate that the shift will not take place until Saturday, 28 February.

item.title: Balearic government blamed for increasing tourist overcrowding: Tension mounts over foreign property debate
item.description: Tomorrow, Tuesday, parliament will debate a motion to ban non-resident property purchases.MÉS per Mallorca has criticised the Partido Popular and Vox for not supporting the bill to ban non-residents of the Balearics from buying property, which will be debated on Tuesday.

item.title: Mallorca to spy on hire cars with over 200 cameras
item.description: Last week, shipping companies were asked to provide detailed information on the volume of vehicles arriving on the island, specifying how many have foreign number plates. Once this data is available, a starting point can be established to determine the limits for rental car fleets on the island.

item.title: Four Seasons Resort Mallorca set to reopen in March with major wellness upgrade and new dining experiences
item.description: The reopening comes amid a rising interest in wellness tourism, a key trend this year.

item.title: Former UK ambassador to US Peter Mandelson arrested
item.description: Police earlier this month ‌began a criminal investigation into Mandelson after Prime Minister Keir ⁠Starmer's government passed ‌on communications between the former ambassador and Epstein.

item.title: Dense fog blankets Palma as yellow warning covers much of Mallorca
item.description: Dense fog covered Palma this Monday afternoon, transforming the Balearic capital's usual cityscape into a muted, misty scene. This weather phenomenon has led to reduced visibility, prompting drivers to exercise increased caution on the roads.

item.title: The spectacular moment the fog takes over Palma Airport
item.description: Palma Airport in the Balearic Islands experienced significantly reduced visibility this Monday as thick fog rolled in from the Mediterranean Sea. Air traffic controllers observed the dense layer of mist gradually encasing the airfield, affecting operations at Son Sant Joan airport.

item.title: Real Mallorca sack coach Arrasate
item.description: The sacking of Jagoba Arrasate came as no surprise.
